metric_definitions.hit_rate: Fraction of cases with at least one labelled relevant chunk in the top k.
metric_definitions.precision: Mean labelled relevant chunks retrieved divided by k.
metric_definitions.recall: Mean labelled relevant chunks retrieved divided by all labelled relevant chunks for that case.
metric_definitions.mrr: Mean reciprocal rank of the first labelled relevant chunk; zero when absent from the top k.
